headline: Nagarjuna Agri Tech Q2FY27 Results
summary: Nagarjuna Agri Tech reported a standalone net profit of ₹38.74 lakh for Q2FY27, down from ₹47.47 lakh YoY. Consolidated revenue rose to ₹2,639.99 lakh.

headline: Ashoka Buildcon wins L-1 bid for ₹1,465 crore NHAI project
summary: Ashoka Buildcon has emerged as the lowest bidder (L-1) for a ₹1,465 crore NHAI EPC project in Gujarat, marking a significant order win for the infrastructure firm.

headline: Signatureglobal subsidiary wins ₹194.19 crore land bid
summary: Signatureglobal (India)'s subsidiary Maa Vaishno Net-tech emerged as the successful bidder for 474.66 acres of land in Raigad, Maharashtra for ₹194.19 crore.

headline: Lineage Power wins ₹194.06 million BESS order
summary: Pace Digitek's subsidiary Lineage Power has received a purchase order worth ₹194.06 million from Insolare Energy for a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS).

headline: Khazanchi Jewellers targets ₹5,000 crore revenue by 2030
summary: Khazanchi Jewellers targets ₹5,000 crore in revenue by 2030, aiming for 25-30% annual growth, a 40% retail share, and 8-10 new stores by FY30.

headline: Stocks to Watch Today: Signatureglobal, Glenmark, Ashoka Buildcon in focus
summary: Signatureglobal rallies 9% on land win and strong sales. Glenmark advances oncology pipeline with FDA IND filing. Ashoka Buildcon bags massive NHAI orders.

headline: Hexaware wins ISG Star of Excellence for 7th year
summary: Hexaware Technologies secured the 2026 ISG Star of Excellence Award in the Client Champion category, marking seven consecutive years of recognition.

headline: Exide Industries cuts stake in Ulric Renewables to 26.07%
summary: Exide Industries has reduced its shareholding in Ulric Renewables to 26.07% following a delay in the 10.5 MW wind project in Maharashtra.

headline: Cipla's InvaGen US facility receives USFDA NAI status
summary: Cipla's InvaGen facility in the US has received a No Action Indicated (NAI) status from the USFDA, reflecting a clean inspection outcome for the manufacturing site.

summary: CLSA maintains a Hold rating on HCL Technologies with a target price of ₹1,094, noting its broad AI portfolio spanning services, software, ER&D, and datacentre investments including Sarvam.

headline: HSBC raises Dr Reddy's target price to ₹1525
summary: HSBC maintains a Buy rating on Dr Reddy's Laboratories and raises its target price to ₹1525, noting 2QFY27 operational performance was broadly in line with expectations.

summary: HSBC reiterates a Buy rating on Syrma SGS with a target price of ₹2,000, citing a diversified electronics portfolio, a ₹74bn order book, and a US$1bn revenue target by FY28.

headline: India 10-year bond yield eases to 7.2423%
summary: India's 10-year benchmark government bond yield declined to 7.2423% from the previous close of 7.2528%, reflecting a marginal easing in sovereign borrowing costs.

headline: IIFL Finance shares flag large-trade signal on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged ~5,61,02,459 IIFL Finance shares worth ₹3,568.12 crore changing hands on BSE at ₹636 per share during the pre-open session.

headline: LPG subsidy cost rises to ₹370 per cylinder
summary: Government LPG under-recovery burden increases to ₹370 per cylinder in December from ₹325. OMCs award 2.75 million tonne US LPG import deal for 2027.

headline: Construction equipment demand seen picking up in H2
summary: An industry body has indicated that demand for construction equipment is expected to pick up in the second half of the year, signalling a potential recovery in the sector.

summary: Tata Consultancy Services is in early talks to acquire a portion of Bosch's India technology operations, with up to 3,000 workers potentially transferring. A board decision is expected next month.

headline: India may extend local content rules to renewable energy
summary: India is likely to extend local content requirements to non-subsidised renewable energy projects, a move expected to boost demand for domestically manufactured batteries.

headline: Azad Engineering sees ₹835.62 crore NSE block trade
summary: A block trade of approximately 3,627,746 shares of Azad Engineering was executed on the NSE at ₹2,303.40 per share, totalling ₹835.62 crore.

summary: Kellton Tech Solutions launched KeOS, an enterprise agentic AI platform. It governs AI agents with cost tracking and custom benchmarks, reducing loan processing time by 47% in a pilot.

headline: Nucleus Software upgrades KIFS Housing in 29 days
summary: Nucleus Software Exports completed a FinOne Neo 9.0 upgrade for KIFS Housing Finance in 29 days with only four hours of downtime and no major issues reported.

headline: Kilburn promoter buys 50,000 shares via open market

summary: IG Petrochemicals is under a GST inspection by the Maharashtra State Tax Commissioner. The company is fully cooperating and reports no impact on its financials or operations.

summary: Hindustan Organic Chemicals Ltd extends temporary shutdown of its Kochi phenol plant by one week for H2 pipeline maintenance. The unit remains offline as of November 18, 2026.

summary: Fusion Finance Limited announced analyst and institutional investor meetings for November 25-26, 2026. The sessions will be held in-person in Mumbai.

headline: Prerna Infrabuild promoter sells 25,001 shares

headline: Fidelity raises Meesho stake to 5.10%
summary: FMR LLC and FIL Limited acquired 20.12 million shares of Meesho Ltd in the open market on November 13, 2026, increasing their aggregate holding to 5.10%.

summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 2,50,033 Coforge shares changing hands on BSE at ₹2043.00, with a combined value of ₹51.08 crore.

summary: Tata Steel CEO confirms coking coal imports are primarily from Australia. The company has sought financial assistance from the Dutch government, which remains under discussion.

summary: Zodiac Ventures Ltd shareholders approved re-appointments of Jimit Ramesh Shah and Ramesh Virji Shah, plus new independent director appointment via e-voting.

summary: Fedders Holding Limited filed its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, with BSE.

headline: Aspira Pathlab promoter acquires 23,834 shares
summary: Jay Arvind Bhanushali acquired 23,834 equity shares of Aspira Pathlab & Diagnostics Ltd in the open market, raising his stake to 7.54%.

summary: Datakosa Limited received BSE approval for 20,58,822 preferential shares. Trading begins November 18, 2026. Shares carry a lock-in until May 2027.

headline: DSP MF cuts Ahluwalia stake to 2.45%

summary: SBI Mutual Fund sold 10,137 shares of Privi Speciality Chemicals, reducing its holding to 5.3363% on November 16, 2026.

headline: Puravankara launches Purva Cityspire in Kochi
summary: Puravankara launches Purva Cityspire in Kochi with a GDV of ₹2,000 crore, featuring 1,056 luxury homes and more than 40 amenities.

summary: Ginni Filaments reported a 6.9% YoY decline in net profit for Q2FY27 despite 6.5% revenue growth. The company also resubmitted results in machine-readable format.

summary: The Draft Red Herring Prospectus for abc, last updated on 18-Nov-2026, currently lacks populated financial, business, and offer details. Key metrics remain unavailable.

headline: Greenlam Industries shares flag large-trade signal

summary: Hirect has secured an order worth ₹136.26 crore from Chittaranjan Locomotive Works for the supply of 900 traction motors, marking a significant win in the railway sector.

summary: Brahmaputra Infrastructure has received approval for a ₹16.06 crore project to construct a bridge and roads in Assam, with an expected completion timeline of 18 months.

summary: SMALLCAP World Fund sold 1,999,032 shares of Home First Finance, reducing its holding to 5.77% via open market sale on November 16, 2026.

summary: Kalpataru Projects International's Dubai branch paid AED 420,000 (~INR 1.07 crore) for UAE employment violations. The company states the penalty has no significant impact on operations.

headline: Fujiyama Power to host plant visit on Nov 23
summary: Fujiyama Power Systems Ltd will conduct a physical plant visit at Greater Noida and Dadri facilities for investors and analysts on November 23, 2026.

headline: DB Stock Brokers approves retail business transfer to Choice

headline: Aurobindo Pharma seeks shareholder approval for director reappointment and pay hikes
summary: Aurobindo Pharma initiates postal ballot for M. R. Kumar's second term as Independent Director and remuneration revisions for top executives effective November 1, 2026.

headline: Sugs Lloyd promoter buys 2,000 shares

summary: Inter State Oil Carrier handled 28.31 '000 MTs in October 2026, marking a 28.3% year-on-year increase and a 1.54% month-on-month rise.

summary: Signature Global has launched projects worth ₹4,400 crore in the first half of the year, targeting a total of ₹15,000 crore in new launches for the full year.

headline: PTC India Financial Services to host DAM Capital investor meet
summary: PTC India Financial Services Limited will interact with investors via a group meeting organized by DAM Capital on November 25, 2026. The session is in-person.

summary: Yash Innoventures Ltd board meeting on Nov 21, 2026, to approve increasing authorised capital to ₹27 crore and issuing 55 lakh equity shares.

summary: A block trade of approximately 21,00,000 ITC shares was executed on BSE at ₹289.25 per share, with the total deal valued at ₹60.74 crore.

summary: Supra Pacific Financial Services board approved private placement of NCDs up to ₹150 crore. Security to be created on current assets.

summary: Finance Ministry sources have denied a Bloomberg report suggesting a proposed hike in derivatives tax, according to Redbox Global. The denial counters speculation around potential changes to the levy.

summary: Seamec's vessel Seamec Agastya is scheduled to be off-hired for repairs at Cochin Shipyard starting November 18, 2026, temporarily taking the vessel out of service.
